rules.value_choice: per sample year, the first source in priority order that has a value within tolerance
rules.hanson_p117: N=d*A^p, d=42.08, p=1.335 fitted to Hanson-Ortman 2017 sample (115/125 pairs within 5%); only cities with Start<=117<=End; model estimate, not a count
rules.b2l: citypop_le5*1000; 0 means below 5,000 -> blank; where a place has a B2L row, B2L is authoritative for 1000/1500/1800 (no fallback to Chandler/Modelski)
rules.reba_cert3: places formed only by Reba rows with Certainty 3 (low location certainty) are not placed: Bergisch Gladbach; Berwick-upon-Tweed; Chorzow; Darlington; Elvira; Fua; Hydra; Kalaa; La Spezia; Ohrid; Piotrkow; Torquay
rules.ne: POP2020*1000 (field is in thousands; UN WUP agglomeration, dated 2020) else POP_MAX (undated, NE v5.1.2) as source ne-popmax
rules.dedup: same place if <10 km (<25 km when a Reba/Chandler-Modelski row with Certainty 1-2 is involved, <100 km for Certainty 3: Reba geocodes are often 10-35 km off) and a name/alias match (exact, prefix>=4 chars, or difflib ratio>=0.85), or <2.5 km regardless of name; constrained single-link, a merged place never holds two rows of the same source
rules.keep: max population >= 5000 in any sample year, or listed by Hanson 2016
rules.port: Hanson Monuments Harbour*/Lighthouse* (no "?"), or Pleiades port/harbor (precise) or NE port within 5 km
rules.sources_column: all sources matched to the place (population, port or Hanson membership), not only the ones whose value was chosen
